task_description: Add atomic fail-closed self-update (clean-tree guard, fetch, ff-only, audit gates, rollback) with skill and tests
ground_truth_scope_source: maintainer policy annotation (README section 4): scripts/update.py adds public API surface (module-level defs)
ground_truth_outcome: merged; suite green at merge time (replayed by this harness)
known_failure_modes: fast-forward merge without a clean-tree guard corrupts local work
update continuing after a failed audit gate instead of rolling back
historical_lesson: self-update protocol is strictly ordered: clean-tree guard -> fetch/diff -> ff-only -> ABI+ruff+pytest audit -> rollback (git reset --hard HEAD@{1}) on any gate failure

task_description: Implement S0-S4 scope resolver, evidence engine with tree binding, isolated check runner, and fix ledger questions/read-receipt invariants
ground_truth_scope_source: maintainer policy annotation (README section 4): three added modules expose public API; no root toolchain config (.gitignore is not a policy S4 path)
ground_truth_outcome: merged; suite green at merge time (replayed by this harness)
known_failure_modes: treating state['questions'] as a list: gate()/status consume dict .items() and crash
closed question referencing a missing checkpoint raised a raw StopIteration instead of ControlError
read receipts were never persisted (missing save), making the ship gate unpassable from the CLI
.jspace/evidence.json was not git-ignored, so the first evidence seal dirtied the tree it had just verified
historical_lesson: the ledger questions contract is a dict keyed by str(qid); closed questions require an existing checkpoint with unchanged evidence, and read receipts must be saved on every control.py read

task_description: Add live project orientation (facts + provenance, quick/standard/deep modes, tree-hash cache) via project_map.py and control.py orient
ground_truth_scope_source: maintainer policy annotation (README section 4): mypy.ini root toolchain config added
ground_truth_outcome: merged; suite green at merge time (replayed by this harness)
known_failure_modes: text-regex dynamic-construct detection matched its own warning label (false provenance): AST node scan required
sorted() over dicts raised TypeError in layout_facts (sort keys, then map)
--root placed after the subcommand is rejected by argparse (globals must precede it)
historical_lesson: orientation facts must be provenance-checked at AST level: a claim is only a fact when an observable node backs it, never a regex hit on a string literal

task_description: Add Mem0-backed institutional memory (categories, precedence, stale marking, bounded retrieval, context synthesis) behind a single adapter
ground_truth_scope_source: maintainer policy annotation (README section 4): mypy.ini root toolchain config modified
ground_truth_outcome: merged; suite green at merge time (replayed by this harness)
known_failure_modes: mem0 embedder config validator rejects provider 'mock' unless built with model_construct plus a factory registry entry
context computed staleness without persisting it (stale count stayed 0 in memory status)
S110 noqa placed on the try line instead of the except line did not suppress the rule
historical_lesson: mem0 offline profile: mock embedder via EmbedderFactory setdefault + model_construct, infer=False for zero LLM calls; memory context must persist stale marks, current ORIENT facts always win
